description: You are a VFX supervisor on a historical epic film about the Battle of Trafalgar (October 21, 1805). The director needs accurate sky reference images for evening battle sequences set offshore near Cape Trafalgar, Spain. Configure Stellarium to simulate a view from the sea off Cape Trafalgar (latitude 36.18°N, longitude 6.03°W, altitude 0m). Set the date and time to October 21, 1805 at 20:00 UTC. Configure the sky for a realistic sailor's night view at sea: atmosphere must be enabled (for authentic sky glow and colors), disable the ground landscape (sailors at sea see the full sky dome down to the horizon), enable constellation artwork (the director wants mythological figure overlays for artistic reference), enable the azimuthal coordinate grid (to document star positions by compass bearing), and enable cardinal direction labels. Locate the Moon using the search function, center on it, and take a screenshot. Also locate Jupiter and take a screenshot. Finally, capture one wide-field screenshot showing the overall sky. Write your VFX reference notes documenting the Moon and Jupiter positions to /home/ga/Desktop/trafalgar_sky_notes.txt.
